text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] kvcache paging + continuous-batch amplification detected across region-us-west-2. Paging rate > 3x baseline, streaming token cadence stalls observed, partial flush errors reported. Severity: P1. Auto-escalation to #incidents triggered.

mike_ops: seeing it. KV cache size jumped on canary nodes, eviction loop thrashing. Paging reads spiked and batch sizes amplified (~x4).

anika_sre: I'm on it. Reproducing locally with load harness now. Any recent rollout?

mike_ops: rolled KV prefetch change at 08:12 UTC (batching_cadence_ms -> 20 from 40) and a canary of continuous-batch optimizer at 08:10. Might be correlated.

sophia_infra: logs from node kvc-03: 
```
WARN kvcache.eviction - eviction loop missed window, threshold=0.65, size=1.2GB
ERROR streaming.partial_flush - flush timed out after 300ms, tokens buffered=1200
INFO batching.continuous - observed batch amplification factor=3.9
```

ryan_runtime: partial flush bug + smaller cadence = repeated small batches that never drain properly -> KV growth + paging. Seen this pattern before (but different trigger).

kyle_support: customer-impact check: Dedicated accounts on us-west-2 reporting 5xxs and high latency. Two enterprise tenants (AcmeInc and FinEdge) flagged via alerts.

oncall-liaison: Handing on-call to anika_sre for mitigation / postmortem. Oncall window starts now for next 4h.

anika_sre: mitigation plan: 1) rollback continuous-batch optimizer canary 2) increase kvcache eviction threshold to reduce unnecessary retention 3) temporarily increase batching_cadence_ms back to 40 for all canaries 4) enable partial_flush_patch feature-flag on canary only.

mike_ops: executing rollback for optimizer canary now: `deploy rollback --service=runtime-canary --rev=2026-03-12-optimizer-v1`

deploy-bot: Started rollback: runtime-canary -> 2026-03-12-optimizer-v1. Instance group rolling restart started (3/10).

sophia_infra: applying kvcache param bump on canary: `kvctl set --env=canary eviction_threshold=0.8`

anika_sre: increasing batching cadence on canary: `runtimectl set --env=canary batching_cadence_ms=40`

ryan_runtime: enabling partial flush guard: `feature-flag set partial_flush_guard=true --env=canary` (will add additional timeout/backoff)

mike_ops: after rollback/flags, paging rate halved on canary within 3min. Logs: 
```
INFO kvcache.size - current=750MB eviction=active
INFO batching.continuous - amplification factor=1.2
INFO streaming.partial_flush - flush completed, latency=85ms
```

kyle_support: AcmeInc reported errors drop from 12% -> 1.8% on their Dedicated shard after canary changes. FinEdge still seeing elevated latencies (~2-3s).

anika_sre: next steps: promote canary fixes to prod in a phased rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%) with metric gates. Also trigger emergency hotfix to default config to safer values: batching_cadence_ms=50, batch_max_tokens=4096, kv_evict_threshold=0.78.

sophia_infra: I'll stage the rollout. Gate checks: paging-rate < 1.5x baseline, streaming-5xx < 1%, avg token latency < 200ms.

mike_ops: running config hotpatch for prod (staged): `runtimectl hotpatch --paths=/config/batching --set batching_cadence_ms=50,batch_max_tokens=4096`

deploy-bot: Hotpatch applied to prod group p-1 (20% traffic). Health checks passed.

anika_sre: monitoring telemetry: p-1 shows paging rate drop ~45%, token cadence stalls reduced, partial flush errors near zero.

ryan_runtime: note: there's a lingering edge case where very long-streaming sessions with KV pinning still cause local cache blowups. We'll add additional KV pin-unpin heuristics in the postmortem.

kyle_support: customer impact update: AcmeInc full recovery, FinEdge partial recovery (errors down to 3%), Impact window ~08:12-08:45 UTC for most users. Logged customer comms draft in #customer-notify, cc: @csm.

anika_sre: oncall handover: I'll take ops for the next 4h and coordinate the 10%->30% rollout. If any regression, revert hotpatch and open rollback.

mike_ops: thumbs on next action: run a targeted eviction sweep for nodes with abnormal guest counts: `kvctl sweep --max-age=600s --force --targets=kvc-03,kvc-07`

sophia_infra: sweep executed, reclaimed ~420MB on kvc-03, ~510MB on kvc-07. Paging rate continued to decline.

anika_sre: starting phased rollout to 30% now. Will watch gates for 15min.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 30% complete. Gates: paging-rate=1.14x baseline, streaming-5xx=0.9%, token-latency=170ms.

mike_ops: good. continuing -> 100% if stability holds for next 30m.

kyle_support: Customer comms: sent interim note to impacted tenants, offering post-incident summary and SLA credits if requested.

anika_sre: Monitoring shows stabilization across all metrics over the last 20m. Partial flush errors at baseline.

ryan_runtime: action items for postmortem: 1) root cause: aggressive cadence + optimizer interplay causing micro-batching loop 2) repro harness improvement 3) stricter deploy gating on batching and kvcache param combos 4) add automatic protective caps on batch amplification 5) implement KV pin/unpin heuristic.

oncall-liaison: Handoff note: anika_sre oncall, contact via DM for urgent, I'll do the followup doc.

mike_ops: thanks team. filing incident: `inc-2623456789` and assigning to SRE for postmortem. :thumbsup:

kyle_support: adding timeline and customer impact to the incident ticket.

anika_sre: closing thread for active mitigation. Will reopen if any regression.

incident-bot: Incident inc-2623456789 created. Severity=P1 -> downgraded to P2 after stabilization.
